title: 第27章 你不要过来啊！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
“真的假的？”胡大彪很是怀疑地问道。

    真有这么巧的事？说曹操曹操就到？

    “比真的还真，就是这小子！”余文宏无比肯定地说道。

    虽然就和梁惟石见过一面，但对方仅仅比他高那么一点儿的身形，以及仅仅比他英俊那么一点儿的容颜，早已深深地刻进了他的脑海里。

    别说梁惟石只换了件衣服，就算是化成骨灰盒，他也能一眼认出来。

    胡大彪和郭铁顿时来了精神，哎呀妈呀，还有这种好事儿？

    于是不约而同地向许彦霖和潘春宇投去征求的目光，意思是弄啊，还是不弄，您二位说了算。

    许彦霖和潘春宇相视一眼，缓缓点了点头。

    这小子既然都主动送上门来了，不弄他还留着过年吗？

    丁强见状心中不由一急，连忙说道：“我手下就在旁边的烧烤摊，等我打电话叫人。”

    胡大彪冷笑一声说道：“用不着，我和刀子两个人就够了。”

    随后又向许彦霖、潘春宇谄媚一笑：“还得劳烦您两二位站远点儿，待会儿我和刀子下手没个轻重，别崩您二位一身血。”

    话一说完，两人立刻摩拳擦掌，大步冲了上去。

    无可奈何的丁强只好大声提醒道：“你们俩小心点儿，姓梁的小子不好对付！”

    梁惟石刚要推开饭庄的迎宾门，忽然听到后面有人在喊‘姓梁的小子’云云，心中不禁警铃大作，猛一回头，正看见两个彪型大汉一脸狞笑地向他奔来。

    其中一人的手上隐有寒光闪动，在迅速与他拉近距离之后，直接就是一个黑虎掏心，狠狠向他肚子捅来。

    梁惟石本能地做出了侧身闪避的动作，但郭铁作为常青市最有名的打手，其打斗经验十分丰富，立刻变捅为划，锋利的刀刃唰的一下，在梁惟石的手臂上留下一道长长的血痕。

    与此同时，胡大彪也扑了上来，一拳砸向梁惟石的面门。
content_en:
"Real or false?" Hu Dabiao asked suspiciously.

    Is it really such a coincidence? If you say Cao Cao, Cao Cao will arrive?

    "More real than real, it's this kid!" Yu Wenhong said with great certainty.

    Although he had met Liang Weishi once, his figure, which was only slightly taller than him, and his appearance, which was only slightly more handsome than him, had already been deeply engraved in his mind.

    Not to mention that Liang Weishi only changed his clothes, even if he turned into an urn, he could still recognize it at a glance.

    Hu Dabiao and Guo Tie suddenly became energetic. Oh my god, is there such a good thing?

    So they unanimously cast a pleading look at Xu Yanlin and Pan Chunyu, meaning whether to do it or not, you two have the final say.

    Xu Yanlin and Pan Chunyu looked at each other and nodded slowly.

    Since this kid has already come to your doorstep, why don't you keep him here for the New Year?

    Ding Qiang couldn't help but feel anxious when he saw this, and said quickly: "My men are at the barbecue stall nearby, waiting for me to call someone."

    Hu Dabiao sneered and said, "No need, Daozi and I are enough."

    Then he smiled flatteringly at Xu Yanlin and Pan Chunyu: "I have to trouble you two to stand far away. The knife and I will attack later, so we don't bleed you two."

    As soon as they finished speaking, the two immediately geared up and rushed forward.

    Ding Qiang had no choice but to remind him loudly: "You two, be careful, the boy named Liang is difficult to deal with!"

    Just as Liang Weishi was about to open the welcoming door of the restaurant, he suddenly heard someone shouting "boy named Liang" from behind. His alarm bells rang loudly in his heart. He turned around and saw two burly men running towards him with ferocious smiles on their faces.

    There was a cold light flashing on the hand of one of them. After quickly closing the distance with him, a black tiger ripped out his heart and stabbed him in the stomach.

    Liang Weishi instinctively made a move to dodge sideways, but Guo Tie, as the most famous thug in Changqing City, has rich fighting experience, immediately changed from stabbing to slashing, and the sharp blade swiped, leaving a long blood mark on Liang Weishi's arm.

    At the same time, Hu Dabiao also rushed forward and punched Liang Weishi in the face.
